en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad square with a large monument featuring a statue of a standing figure on a tall pedestal, surrounded by smaller sculptures. People walk and a horse‑drawn carriage passes in the foreground. Behind the square rise trees, historic buildings, and a church tower, with tall mountains in the background. Printed red text in the upper right reads "Trento Piazza Dante e Monte Terra Rossa," and at the bottom right "Luigi Marsoner, Trento." There is also a handwritten signature on the right side.
